title: Quiet Moments
lyrics:
[Instrumental Piano Solo]

This piece features:
- Gentle arpeggiated passages in D major
- Reflective melodic themes that rise and fall
- Moments of silence between phrases
- A contemplative middle section in the relative minor
- Gradual resolution returning to the opening theme
- Soft sustain pedal throughout for warmth

Perfect for meditation, study, or quiet reflection.

title: Moonlight Serenade
lyrics:
[Orchestral Instrumental]

Movement Structure:

I. Adagio - Opening theme introduced by strings
   - Soft, legato melody in B-flat major
   - French horns provide harmonic foundation

II. Andante - Development section
   - Woodwinds carry the melody
   - Gentle pizzicato accompaniment
   - Building emotional intensity

III. Largo - Return to opening
   - Full orchestra statement of theme
   - Harp glissandos evoking moonlight on water
   - Gradual diminuendo to whispered ending

Instrumentation: Full chamber orchestra with featured harp

Everything is feeling right

Move your body, show me how

Smile upon your face

Sitting in my room alone
Picking at my phone
Wondering if you still think of me

Chorus:

Every word you said
Still echoing in my head

Photos on my bedside stand
Remember holding your hand
Simpler times before goodbye
Before you made me cry

(Chorus)

Bridge:
I know I should move on
But the feeling's not gone
Maybe someday I'll be free
But you're still a part of me

(Chorus)

Outro:
Heartstrings... you pull my heartstrings

Nature's sweet symphony
As morning light unfolds
New stories to be told

Verse 2:
Wandering through the misty fields
Wondering what today will yield
Coffee steam and quiet thoughts
Cherishing what cannot be bought

Every sunrise is a gift
Every moment gives me a lift
In the stillness, peace I find
Leaving yesterday behind

(Chorus)

title: Pacific Highway

Windows down and stereo loud
Sunset painting every cloud
Cruising down the coastal line
Salt air and summer time

Pacific Highway, where I want to stay
Waves are crashing on the shore
This is what I'm living for

Surfboard strapped up on the roof
Chasing waves, chasing youth
Endless summer, endless ride
Ocean blue on every side

(Chorus)

With the ocean as my guide
Everything feels right

(Chorus)

title: Midnight Protocol

Encrypted messages in the dark
Digital footprints leave their mark
Running silent through the code
Following the midnight road

Chorus:
Midnight protocol, engage
Step into the digital age
Midnight protocol, online
Crossing every firewall line

Neon screens illuminate
Data streams that never wait

Answering the system calls

(Chorus)

Piano plays a tune I know

Blue note, make my heart beat

Wherever the music wants to go

(Chorus)

In every blue note
A perfect sound

[Sax Solo]

(Chorus)

Outro:

title: Floating

The autumn leaves are falling down
Painting orange across the town
Summer's gone, the air turns cold
Another year is growing old

Chorus:
Autumn leaves, drifting by

Seasons change, time moves on

Walking through the forest trail
Footsteps crunching without fail
Memories of warmer days
Fading in the autumn haze

(Chorus)

In the changing seasons, we grow
Every ending starts anew
Through the falling leaves, I see you

(Chorus)

Supernova! Exploding bright

A billion colors in the sky

(Chorus)

title: Nocturne
lyrics: [Instrumental]

lyrics:
Verse 1:
Across the golden dunes we ride
Ancient secrets they still hide
Caravan beneath the sun
Where earth and sky are one

Chorus:
Sahara wind, carry me away
Sahara wind, through night and day
Whispering the songs of old
Stories waiting to be told

Oasis dreams and starlit nights
Campfires burning, desert lights
Drums are beating, voices rise
Underneath the endless skies

(Chorus)

title: Symphony No. 5
lyrics: [Orchestral]

title: Street Dreams
lyrics:
Verse 1:
Grew up on the corner where the streetlights dim
Mama working double shifts, life looking grim
But I had a notebook and a dream inside
Put my soul in these lyrics, couldn't let it hide
Teachers said I wouldn't make it, wouldn't amount to none
But here I am now, look what I've become

Chorus:
Street dreams, that's all I had
Street dreams, turned good from bad
From the concrete where the roses grow
Street dreams, this is all I know

Verse 2:
Late nights in the studio, perfecting my flow
Every verse a story that the world should know
For my homies locked up, for the ones who fell
I'm the voice of the voiceless, got stories to tell

(Chorus)

Bridge:
They said we wouldn't make it
But we took it and we ran
Street dreams to reality
Stick to the plan

(Chorus)

title: Thunder Road
lyrics:
Verse 1:
Screen door slams, Mary's dress waves
Like a vision she dances across the porch
As the radio plays
Young and restless, we had nothing to prove
But everything to gain on thunder road

Chorus:
Thunder road, take us away tonight
Thunder road, into the fading light
Windows down and the music loud
Thunder road, making our hometown proud

Verse 2:
Two kids with a tank full of dreams
Leaving it all behind, or so it seems
The factory smokestacks in our rear view
Chasing something real, something true

(Chorus)

Bridge:
We were born to run
Chasing that setting sun
Nothing but the open road
And each other to hold

[Guitar Solo]

(Chorus)

Outro:
Thunder road... take me home

title: Stargazer
lyrics:
Verse 1:
Lying on the rooftop, you and me
Counting constellations, running free
City lights below us fade away
In this moment, I just want to stay

Pre-Chorus:
Make a wish upon a shooting star
Doesn't matter who we are

Chorus:
Stargazer, lost in your eyes
Stargazer, under the skies
You make me feel like I can fly
Stargazer, you and I

Verse 2:
Whisper secrets only stars will hear
In your arms I've got nothing to fear
The universe is ours tonight
Everything is feeling right

(Pre-Chorus)
(Chorus)

Bridge:
If I'm dreaming, don't wake me up
I've finally found someone to love
Among the stars we'll always be
Just you and me

(Chorus)

Outro:
Stargazer... stargazer

title: Gospel Train
lyrics:
Verse 1:
There's a train a-coming, glory bound
Peace and joy is what I've found
Leave your troubles at the station door
You won't need them anymore

Chorus:
All aboard the gospel train!
Washing away your sorrow and pain
Gospel train, taking us home
Never again to roam alone

Verse 2:
Sinners welcome, saints rejoice
Lift your hands and raise your voice
Heaven's gates are open wide
Jesus waiting on the other side

(Chorus)

Bridge:
Hallelujah! Praise His name!
Our God is good, He remains the same
Clap your hands and stomp your feet
This gospel train can't be beat!

(Chorus)

Outro:
Gospel train... coming home!
Glory, glory, hallelujah!

title: Berlin Underground

Raindrops falling on my window pane
Gentle rhythm, washing away the pain

Chorus:

Finding shelter, finding truth
Simple melodies, nothing grand
Just this music and my hands

(Chorus)

To feel the calm that follows
Some days you need the grey
To see the bright tomorrows

(Chorus)

Outro:
Acoustic rain... soft and slow

(Chorus)

(Chorus)

(Chorus)
